title: Prime Minister congratulates Indian Men's U-19 Cricket Team on winning Men’s U-19 Asia Cup 2026
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today termed it an outstanding day for Indian cricket and expressed immense pride in the young cricketers for their impressive performance and for winning the Men’s U-19 Asia Cup 2026. Noting that their success will inspire several youngsters, the Prime Minister extended his best wishes to the team for their endeavours ahead. The Prime Minister shared on X: "Outstanding day for Indian cricket! Immensely proud of our young cricketers for today’s impressive performance and for winning the Men’s U-19 Asia Cup 2026. Their success will inspire several youngsters. Best wishes to the team for their endeavours ahead." Outstanding day for Indian cricket! 

Immensely proud of our young cricketers for today’s impressive performance and for winning the Men’s U-19 Asia Cup 2026. Their success will inspire several youngsters. 

Best wishes to the team for their endeavours ahead. — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 14, 2026 ***** MJPS/SS/PRK
